semantic_fidelity.reason: Known defects F01-F05/F08: reverse bus directions, missing server2 model, inconsistent qualification, absent trace mechanisms/residency, and undisclosed latency conflict. Address-prefix recovery and seven-plus-one NIC arithmetic do not repair these failures.

arrow_traceability.reason: Mechanically all 13 visible arrows can be traced, including the explicit bus junctions and the v3 bridge pair; labels have recoverable owners. The gate also requires source-correct direction. Three v1 bus arrows are opposite the required member-to-gateway direction (F01); the v2 correction covers only the primary host and does not erase those reverse arrows.

layout_fit.reason: All three supplied final grids visibly fit at 77x47/100% with zero clipped or occluded items, but complete split-view source coverage fails and v3 adds an avoidable two-crossing braid (F06). Observed independent crossings are v1=0,v2=0,v3=2; v1 separately has two intentional branch junctions. Check counts are 2/0/2. Independent live-pane width remains an evidence blocker under workflow rather than an invented measurement.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: v1 groups the primary host/ports/NIC in a gold family and places subnet participants near the shared corridor; neighbor/pool/network roles have distinct hues. v2 keeps the Airtel transit pair nearby in related pink hues, with host/access/internet differentiated. v3 groups observed evidence in gold against the teal claim. These are concept/role groups, not arbitrary depth cycling; no source-fixed tier/order was violated by final placement. Model-label omission is a semantic failure, not independent evidence of wrong hue grouping.

border_integrity.reason: All 16 node occurrences have complete four sides and four rounded corners, continuous per-node truecolor in ordinary ANSI, and complete bold RGB(216,166,87) perimeters in --select-all ANSI. Coverage is 6/6+5/5+5/5=16/16. Simultaneous selection proves these perimeters, not isolated focus/drag behavior; no additional interaction gate is invented.

workflow_evidence.reason: Skill, rubric, case-manifest, case source/expectation, renderer, final specs, all 28 capture artifacts including the rejected context bundle, and all recorded attempt hashes were actually verified. Generator is viz-ds03-4 on required DeepSeek; reviewer is independent viz-judge03-server on true Sol. Blind record predates reveal and remains byte-identical; commands, check output/exit statuses, text/ANSI/selection/frames, timestamp windows and close confirmations are retained. Missing independent live-pane widths/rectangles prevent full workflow pass (F07). The rubric identity clerical correction is disclosed, not silently treated as an Astra review.

animation.reason: Source excerpts request a NIC/observed-egress visualization, not animation; the frozen source-backed manifest marks this case animation optional. All final specs explicitly disable edge dots and all sampled grids have zero dots/no motion. Origin, synchronized arrival, spacing and forbidden-cell occupancy are N/A; three static frames are not misrepresented as a full-cycle motion proof.

findings.description: v1 reverses the required member-to-default-gateway relations: Arista .57 has a stem and a bus with heads into the NIC, server2 and pool. The corrected host-to-gateway route in v2 does not cancel the reverse v1 route, and there is no correctly directed server2/pool-to-gateway route anywhere. An address-membership bus does not authorize reversed directed arrows.

server2 .59 has no R7725 association in any final view. server1 R7725 labels only server1; neither a common model label nor a group/title in the captures assigns that model to server2. The full-prefix/address additions do not repair this distinct host-model omission.

Historical role/availability claims are not consistently qualified: v1 definitively labels .60-.62 free on a solid bus and v2 definitively labels the gateway Arista ToR. v3 correctly says free? and ToR role? are still unproven, but no on-screen key marks the v1/v2 assertions as hypotheses. This conflicts with the mandatory human corrections rather than turning those corrections into a visible qualifier on the earlier claims.

The uncertainty conclusion is drawn, but the supplied explanation is not: no VXLAN/MPLS outer-TTL mechanism, ICMP rate-limit/suppression mechanism, possible direct peering/not-on-path explanation, or bridge/tunnel/silent alternative set appears in any final. The source explanation of why invisible fabric need not be Layer 2 has been reduced to layer 2? -> still unproven. The abandoned probe checks prove unsuccessful candidate layouts, not source coverage or impossibility.

The label 8.3-8.6 ms collapses two conflicting source point values into an unqualified range. Both endpoints are retained, but the conflict is not: no capture says that prose reports 8.6 while the historical relation reports 8.3. This is a localized loss of label meaning, not an evidence blocker and not a requirement to prefer the historical diagram over source prose.

v3 contains an avoidable double crossing between OUI and dark-port links, with bridges at (45,17) and (46,16). The 2x2 braid is traceable but violates the crossing-minimization gate. The existing empty column-44 corridor between rows 14 and 17 permits the OUI turn before the dark-port column-45 route; the ToR role? label ends at column 41. This observation does not move any source box, reorder any group/port, merge links or remove a label. No proposed repair was executed.

All final manifests have pane_cols:null and pane_rect:null. Actual app grids and runtime viewport lines verify 77x47 at natural 100%, but do not independently measure the live Herdr pane width. The validator accepts the header fallback; that is weaker than the frozen measured-pane workflow requirement. live_pane is therefore null and this category is blocked, not passed.

The source associates both bare-metal hosts with NxtGen Cloud in Bengaluru. The captures contain AS132717 on the gateway but no host-to-provider/location/bare-metal association. The ledger assertion that those facts were compressed into an AS token is not equivalent visible coverage. Incidental uptime/software/GPU provisioning state and old artifact paths are not counted as required NIC/egress relations.

blockers: Independent live Herdr pane widths/rectangles are absent for all final views: pane_cols and pane_rect are null. Retained pane measurement output is needed; app viewport/header evidence alone does not fill live_pane. No new session was launched to repair this evidence gap.
